newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Novo logs 10 pct H1 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Danish Novo logs 10 pct H1 profit rise.

text.p: Danish drug group Novo Nordisk on Wednesday reported a 10 percent rise in net profit for the first half of 1997 and repeated an earlier forecast of 15 percent growth in operating income for the full year.
Its six month net profit rose to 960 million crowns ($135 million), compared to 873 million during the same period last year and the pre-tax result rose to 1.345 billion crowns from 1.229.
Analysts had, on average, predicted pre-tax profit of 1.272 billion crowns and at 1000 GMT the share was up 2.1 percent, to 719.00 crowns from Tuesday's closing 704.00.
